title: Transsystemic Contracts
description: Examines the circumstances under which the common law and law from selected Indigenous legal orders give force to voluntary obligations between parties. Canvasses general principles of contract law from Canadian and Indigenous case law and statutes. Focuses on contract formation, interpretation, capacity to contract, and remedies.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of LAW 105I, LAW 105, LAW 108A.
